supertram.name: Bristol Supertram
supertram.description: Line One of a light rail scheme backed by the government in 2001: 16 stops over about 17 km from Union Street in the centre via Temple Meads, reopened stations on the Filton Bank line and Bristol Parkway to Aztec West, with an extension proposed to MoD Abbey Wood and UWE. South Gloucestershire withdrew over a Cribbs Causeway extension, and Bristol City Council cancelled the scheme in March 2004.

uwe.name: University of the West of England

mass-transit.name: Bristol underground mass transit
mass-transit.description: Four radial routes from Temple Meads studied for the West of England Combined Authority and made public in November 2022: south to the airport, north to Aztec West and Almondsbury, north-east to the Science Park and south-east to Keynsham, each with an underground option (about £4.5 billion in all). Shown here as the underground options; the scheme remains at feasibility stage.
